name: Noribogainalog
summary: Noribogainalog (nor-IBG), also known as 9-hydroxyibogaminalog or as GATC-021, is a drug of the ibogalog family related to noribogaine. It is a simplified analogue of noribogaine.

pharmacology.text: Noribogainalog acts as a potent serotonin 5-HT2A receptor partial agonist (EC50 ≈ 90 nM; Emax = 35–45%). It is also a partial agonist of the serotonin 5-HT6 receptor (Emax = 29%), whereas it is not an agonist of the serotonin 5-HT2B and 5-HT7 receptors. The drug additionally has activity as a dopamine transporter (DAT) chaperone.
pharmacology.kind: Serotonin receptor modulator; Serotonin 5-HT2A receptor agonist
